name: Temple of the Falcon
description: This ruin used to be a temple devoted to the benevolent Falcon of the West. The Temple of the Falcon has watched over Windrise for thousands of years. Perhaps the winds of the past still linger within its halls.

tabs.name: Explore: Windy Cliff
tabs.description: Though it lies deep underground, the strong winds filled every corridor of the ruin. Don't be discouraged! Find the treasure deep within the ruin!
